Name: Mount Seir in Judah
Description: The Mount Seir named on Judah's northern border, where the boundary compassed from Baalah westward past Chesalon toward Beth-shemesh — a western Seir near Kiriath-jearim, not the mountain of Edom in the south.
BiblicalSignificance: This Seir exists only as a boundary mark in Joshua 15; its position on Judah's north edge proves it cannot be Edom's range, and it must not be merged with it.
